relations.label: mañjuśrīkīrti (8424) lineage predecessor of devacandra (8431)
relations.zotero_refs: [RCJ46BHM]: 338 records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Pa tshab lo tsā ba (ID:3868) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Mañjuśrīkīrti (ID:8424), Devacandra (ID:8431), Brahman Ratnavajra (ID:7726), Parahita (ID:3798), Hasumati (ID:6180), Pa tshab Lo tsā ba (ID:3868), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the lineage of Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329).

relations.label: candrakīrti (3725) lineage predecessor of mañjuśrīkīrti (8424)
relations.zotero_refs: [RCJ46BHM]: 338 records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Pa tshab lo tsā ba (ID:3868) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Mañjuśrīkīrti (ID:8424), Devacandra (ID:8431), Brahman Ratnavajra (ID:7726), Parahita (ID:3798), Hasumati (ID:6180), Pa tshab Lo tsā ba (ID:3868), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the  lineage of Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329).

comments: [RCJ46BHM]: 338, holds he was a teacher of Dīpaṃkaraśrījñāna (ID:3745), the author of a commentary on the Samādhirājasūtra (D 127), called the Kīrtimālā (D 4010) and perhaps also the author of the Mañjuśrīnāmasaṃgitiṭīkā (D 2534). He may be the BDRC figure bdr:P3833 (https://purl.bdrc.io/resource/P3833).
